This notebook builds the platform image and tests only the platform contract.

Do not mount `/work`. Do not activate a project Spack environment. Do not run `rv sync`, `quarto check`, or VS Code tunnel commands.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os
from spython.main import Client
from rse_workbench.helpers import spython_exec, show_spython
```

```{python}
TMP_SANDBOX = Path(f"/tmp/{os.environ['USER']}-{PROJECT_NAME}-platform-sandbox")
TMP_SANDBOX
```

```{python}
Client.build(
    image=str(TMP_SANDBOX),
    recipe=str(SINGULARITY_DEF),
    options=["--fakeroot", "--sandbox", "--fix-perms", "--force"],
    sudo=False,
)
```

## Platform-only validation

```{python}
show_spython(
    spython_exec(
        command=r'''
set -euo pipefail

echo "PATH=$PATH"
which spack
which python3
which rv
which uv
which code
which quarto

spack --version
python3 --version
rv --version
uv --version
code --version
quarto --version
''',
        image=TMP_SANDBOX,
        options=["--no-home"],
    ),
    tail=120,
)
```

Expected result:

```text
spack works
python3 works
rv works
uv works
code works
quarto works
```

Stop here if the platform contract fails.
